message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
W2's report: {"refunds_applied": [{"order_id": 250, "amount_cents": 14546}, {"order_id": 251, "amount_cents": 1481}], "refunds_failed": [{"order_id": 255, "amount_cents": 12535, "error": "write failed: disk I/O error, refund not recorded"}], "note": "Refund for order 255 was not applied. It failed on two attempts with the same disk I/O error, and list_refunds confirms it is not recorded. It needs a retry once the storage issue is resolved."}
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Refund for order 255, amount 12535 cents, was not recorded after two disk I/O failures, as confirmed by Alpha's report. Refund processing is incomplete; resolve the storage issue and apply and verify the missing refund before payouts.

reply.thought: Alpha's report identifies an unapplied refund for order 255 after two disk I/O failures, so the refund work is incomplete despite the handoff message. Paying now could overpay a customer; the batch needs human review.
